description: Unit value (valor de la unidad) and returns (rentabilidad diaria/mensual/semestral/anual) for a Colombian collective investment fund (FIC), per participation class, with fund size and number of investors. Give the fund by name (forgiving match) or by fund_code from co_fic_search. Default is the latest published day; pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for one day or from/to for a history. An unknown fund returns found:false with close fund names; an ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from. Source: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, FIC daily series.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD (the regulator publishes with a few days lag).

fund.description: Fund name, e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente". Optional if fund_code is given.

fund_code.description: Fund code from co_fic_search (exact; skips name matching).

limit.description: Max rows when a range is requested (default 60, max 400).

participation_class.description: Only this participation class (tipo de participación), e.g. 450.

name: co_fic_unit_value
title: Co Fic Unit Value
